```{r}
#| include: false
library(DT)

schedule <- read.csv("schedule.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
schedule$highlight <- tolower(trimws(schedule$highlight))

render_schedule <- function(target_day) {
  df <- subset(schedule, day == target_day)

  df$Artist <- ifelse(
    df$highlight == "yes",
    sprintf("⭐ **<span style='color:#d9534f; font-size:1.1em;'>%s</span>**", df$artist),
    df$artist
  )

  df <- df[, c("time", "venue", "Artist", "highlight")]
  names(df) <- c("Time", "Venue", "Artist", "Highlight")

  DT::datatable(
    df,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 100,
      dom = "ft",
      ordering = TRUE,
      responsive = TRUE
    ),
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Thursday

```{r}
render_schedule("Thurs")
```

## Friday

```{r}
render_schedule("Fri")
```

## Saturday

```{r}
render_schedule("Sat")
```
